Hi all — technical details below, happy to take the export run. Key notes on what we log and how we prepare the package: 

1) Fields captured per event (canonical admin_activity schema):
   - timestamp_utc (ISO8601), actor_principal_id (internal id), actor_email (if applicable; redaction configurable), action_name, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, session_id, ip_address, user_agent, outcome (success/failure), before_state (where applicable), after_state (where applicable), kv_cache_ops (if operator touched runtime cache), routing_decision_id

2) Retention and scope:
   - Default retention: 365 days for admin_activity for enterprise plans; 90 days for hosted starter.
   - Soft-deletes: admin actions flagged as soft-delete are retained by default and included unless customer requests exclusion.

3) Export formats and manifest:
   - Primary export: JSONL (newline-delimited JSON) compressed with gzip, chunked to 5GB compressed shards.
   - Optional Parquet export for analytics by request (faster ingest to internal data lake).
   - Manifest: top-level JSON manifest listing shards, record counts, start/end timestamp per shard, and an HMAC-SHA256 for each shard. We will also provide a CSV manifest with summary rows for quick review. (See attached export-schema-v1.json for field definitions.)

4) Tamper-evidence and chain of custody:
   - We sign the manifest using Redwood platform key; for stronger assurances we can also provide an HMAC keyed by a key you provide (CMK/HMAC).
   - Each shard includes an HMAC-SHA256 (computed server-side) and a signed manifest with a timestamp and agent id.

5) Encryption and KMS:
   - All exports are encrypted at rest with AES-256. In transit we use SFTP (SSH) or HTTPS-TLS1.3.
   - CMK: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted exports we can encrypt with a Redwood-managed CMK but can wrap with a customer-provided key for the archive if required.

6) Redaction and sampling:
   - PII redaction is configurable at field level (masking or removal). For large exports we recommend redaction + a small internal unredacted sample delivered under an NDA.

7) Practical constraints:
   - Export creation is IO/CPU bound; large windows (multiple months) may take longer than 72h depending on volume. For the week requested we anticipate <24h processing.

Attachments: export-schema-v1.json (field definitions).

If you confirm CMK preference and delivery method we will start the export run and push a sample manifest first.

—
Kimberly Park
